description: No first-order theory in the one-relation language has exactly the nonempty strict well-orders as its models.
signature:
Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.ExpressiveLimits.wellOrders_not_axiomatizable :
  ¬∃ T,
      ∀ (M : Type) (x : Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.ExpressiveLimits.language.Structure M),
        Nonempty M →
          (M ⊨ T ↔ Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.ExpressiveLimits.WellOrdered Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.ExpressiveLimits.edge)
